rv.q: Time, in this instance, has been generous.

vs.sum: The Bernard B. Jacobs Theatre offers excellent sightlines from most seats, though comfort is compromised by tight legroom, especially in the mezzanine. The theater's ambiance is enhanced by its historic architecture and unique murals, but restroom facilities are limited, leading to long lines during intermission.

acc.note: 7 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. Copper induction loop available.
